G0800.def:
ἀ-σύμφωνος, -ον
[in LXX: Wis.18:10, Da, LXX, Bel 1:15 * ;]
dissonant, discordant; metaphorically, at variance: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, At 28:25.†
(AS)

G0801.def:
ἀ-σύνετος, -ον
[in LXX: Dt 32:21 (נָבָל). Jó 13:2 (נָפַל), Sl 92:6 (כְּסִיל), Sl 76:5, Wis.2:1-24, Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
without understanding or discernment: Mt 15:16, Mc 7:18 (Swete, in l), Rm 1:21, 31 10:19 (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0802.def:
ἀ-σύν-θετος, -ον
(συντίθεμαι ν. M, Pr., 222; MM, see word), [in LXX: Jr 3:7-11 (בָּגַד)* ;]
false to engagements, not keeping covenant, faithless (MM, see word): Rm 1:31.†
(AS)

G0803.def:
ἀσφάλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for בָּטַח, etc. ;]
__1. firmness.
__2. certainty: Lc 1:4.
__3. security: At 5:23, 1Ts 5:3.
(In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, Th., l.with)†
(AS)

G0804.def:
ἀσφαλής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pu., etc. ;]
certain, secure, safe: At 21:34 22:30 25:26, Fp 3:1, Hb 6:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0805.def:
ἀσφαλίζω
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX: Ne 3:15 (חָזַק hi.), Is 41:10 (תָּמַךְ), Wis.4:17 10:12 13:15 * ;]
to make firm, secure: mid., Mt 27:65-66, At 16:24; pass., Mt 27:64 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0806.def:
ἀσφαλῶς
adv., [in LXX: Gn 34:25 (בֶּטַח), Tob.6:4, Wis.18:6, Bar.5:7, 1Ma.6:40, 3Ma.7:6 * ;]
__(a) safely: Mc 14:44, At 16:23;
__(b) assuredly: At 2:36.†
(AS)

G0807.def:
ἀσχημονέω, -ῶ
(ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: Eze.16:7, 22 16:39 23:29 (עֶרְיָה); Dt 25:3 (קָלָה ni.)* ;]
to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably: 1Co 13:5; before ἐπί, ib. 1Co 7:36 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0808.def:
ἀσχημοσύνη, -ης, ή
(ἀσχήμων), [in LXX chiefly for עֶרְוָה ;]
unseemliness: Rm 1:27 (MM, see word); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as frequently in LXX, shame, nakedness: Ap 16:15.†
(AS)

G0809.def:
ἀσχήμων, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σχῆμα) [in LXX: Gn 34:7 (נְבָלָה), Dt 24:1 (עֶרְוָה), Wis.2:20, Da TH Sus 1:63, 2Ma.9:2 * ;]
__1. shapeless.
__2. uncomely, unseemly: 1Co 12:23.†
(AS)

G0810.def:
ἀσωτία, -ας, ή
(ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: Pv 28:7 (זָלַל), 2Ma.6:4 * ;]
prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy: Ef 5:18, Tt 1:6, 1Pe 4:4 (MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v (AS)

G0811.def:
ἀσώτως
adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, Pv 7:11 * ;]
wastefully: Lc 15:13
(EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).† (AS)

G0812.def:
ἀτακτέω -ῶ
(ἄτακτος),
primarily, of soldiers marching, to be out of order, to quit the ranks; hence, metaphorically, to be remiss, fail in the performance of duty (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): 2Ts 3:7 (on ἀ. and its cognates, see M, Th., 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).†
(AS)

G0813.def:
ἀ-τακτος, -ον
(τάσσω), [in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 * ;]
out of order, out of place (Lat. inordinatus), frequently of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. 3Ma.1:19); hence, metaphorically, irregular, disorderly (see previous word): 1Ts 5:14.†
(AS)

G0815.def:
ἄτεκνος, -ον
(τέκνον), [in LXX: Gn 15:2, Lv 20:20-21 (עֲרִירִי), Is 49:21, Jr 18:21 (שָׁכֹל), Sir.16:3 * ;]
childless: Lc 20:28-29.†
(AS)

G0816.def:
ἀτενίζω
(ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), [in LXX: I Et 6:28, 3Ma.2:26 * ;]
to look fixedly, gaze (MM, see word): with dative of person(s), gaze upon: Lc 4:20 22:56, At 3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), At 3:4 6:15 13:9; metaphorically, At 1:10 7:55 11:6, 2Co 3:7 3:13.†
(AS)

G0817.def:
ἄτερ
prep., [in LXX: 2Ma.12:15 * ;]
in cl. most frequently in poets; without, apart from: with genitive, Lc 22:6, 35 (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0818.def:
ἀτιμάζω
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX for בּוּז, קָלָה, etc. ;]
to dishonour, insult: Mc 12:4, TTr., mg., WH, Lc 20:11, Jo 8:49, Rm 2:23, Tg 2:6; pass.: At 5:41, Rm 1:24 (cf ἀτιμάω).†
(AS)

G0819.def:
ἀτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄτιμος) [in LXX for כְּלִמָּה, קָלוֹן, etc. ;]
dishonour, disgrace: 1Co 11:14, 2Co 6:8; εἰς ἀ., Rm 9:21, 2Tm 2:20; ἐν ἀ., 1Co 15:43; κατ᾽ ἀ., 2Co 11:21; πάθη ἀτιμίας, base passions, Rm 1:26.†
(AS)

G0820.def:
ἄτιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX: Is 3:5 (קָלָה ni.), Is 53:3 (בָּזָה), Jó 30:4, 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5:1-23, Sir.1:1-30 * ;]
without honour, dishonoured, despised: Mt 13:57, Mc 6:4, 1Co 4:10; comp., 1Co 12:23.†
(AS)

G0822.def:
ἀτμίς, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;]
vapour: Tg 4:14; ἀ. καπνοῦ, At 2:19 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0823.def:
ἄ-τομος, -ον
(τέμνω), [in Sm.: Is 54:8 (MM, see word) * ;]
indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., 1Co 15:52.†
(AS)

G0824.def:
ἄ-τοπος, -ον
(τόπος), [in LXX: Jó 4:8 11:11, Pv 30:20, al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;]
__1. out of place, not befitting.
__2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): At 28:6; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,
__3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): Lc 23:41, At 25:5, 2Ts 3:2.†
(AS)

G0825.def:
Ἀτταλία (Rec. -άλεια), -υς, ἡ
Attalia, a city of Pamphylia: At 14:25.†
(AS)

G0826.def:
αὐγάζω
(αὐγή), [in LXX: Lv 13:24-28, 38 14:56 (בֹּהֶרֶת) Lv 13:39 (כֵּהֶה)* ;]
__1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate.
__2. Intrans.
__(a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word)
__(b) as in LXX, to shine forth: 2Co 4:4 (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†
(AS)

G0827.def:
αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Is 59:9 (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12:9 * ;]
__1. brightness
__2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: At 20:11 (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)

G0828.def:
Αὔγουστος, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: Lc 2:1 (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0829.def:
αὐθάδης, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: Gn 49:3, 7 (עַז), Pv 21:24 (יָהִיר)* ;]
self-pleasing, arrogant: Tt 1:7, 2Pe 2:10 (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)

G0830.def:
αὐθαίρετος, -ον
(αὐτός, αἱρέομαι), [in Sm.: Êx 35:5, 22 * ;]
__1. self-chosen.
__2. of one's own accord: 2Co 8:3 8:17.†
(AS)

G0831.def:
αὐθεντέω, -ῶ
(αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wis.12:6; cf. -ία, 3Ma.2:29; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word)
to govern, exercise authority over: 1Tm 2:12.†
(AS)

G0832.def:
αὐλέω, -ῶ
(αὐλός), [in Al.: 3Ki.1:40 * ;]
to play on a flute, to pipe: mid., Mt 11:17, Lc 7:32, 1Co 14:7.†
(AS)

G0833.def:
αὐλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חָצֵר ;]
__1. in Hom., an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold: Jo 10:1, 16
__2. the court, courtyard, round which a house is built: Mt 26:3, 58 26:69, Mc 14:54, 66 15:16 Lc 11:21 22:55, Jo 18:15; τ. ναοῦ, Ap 11:2. a dwelling, a palace (so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): Mt 26:3, 58, Mc 14:54 15:16, Lc 11:21, Jo 18:15 (but see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).†
(AS)

G0834.def:
αὐλητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(αὐλέω),
a flute-player: Mt 9:23, Ap 18:22 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0835.def:
αὐλίζομαι
(αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;]
__1. prop., to lodge in a courtyard.
__2. to lodge in the open.
__3. to pass the night, lodge (LXX; MM, see word): Mt 21:17, Lc 21:37.†
(AS)

G0836.def:
αὐλός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for חָלִיל ;]
a pipe: 1Co 14:7.†
(AS)

G0837.def:
αὐξάνω
(and the earlier form αὔξω, Ef 2:21, Cl 2:19; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה ;]
__1. trans., to make to grow: 1Co 3:6-7, 2Co 9:10. Pass., to grow, increase, become greater: Mt 13:32, Mc 4:8, 2Co 10:15, Cl 1:6; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, Cl 1:10; εἰς σωτηρίαν, 1Pe 2:2.
__2. In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., to grow, increase: of plants, Mt 6:28, Lc 12:27 13:19; of infants, Lc 1:80 2:40; of a multitude, At 7:17; of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, At 6:7 12:24 19:20; of Christ as a leader, Jo 3:30; of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, Ef 4:15; εἰς ναόν, Ef 2:21; ἐν χάριτι, 2Pe 3:18; τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, Cl 2:19 (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).†
(AS)

G0839.def:
αὔριον
adv., [in LXX for מָחָר ;]
to-morrow: Mt 6:30, Lc 12:28, At 23:20 25:22, 1Co 15:32, Lc 13:32-33, Tg 4:13; ἡ αὔ. (sc. ἡμέρα, MM, see word), Mt 6:34, At 4:3; ἐπὶ τὴν αὔ., Lc 10:35, At 4:5; τὸ (WH om.) τῆς Tg 4:14.†
(AS)

G0840.def:
αὐστηρός, -ά, -όν
(αἄω, to dry up) [in LXX: 2Ma.14:30 * ;]
prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, strict, severe (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): Lc 19:21-22.†
SYN.: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv) (AS)

G0841.def:
αὐτάρκεια, -ας, ἡ
(αὐτάρκης, which see),
__(a) sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), 2Co 9:8;
__(b) contentment: 1Tm 6:6.†
(AS)

G0842.def:
αὐτάρκης, -ες
(αὐτός, ἀρκέω), [in LXX: Pv 30:8 (חֹק), Sir.5:1 11:24 31:28 40:18, 4Ma.9:9 * ;]
as in cl., in philosophical sense, self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented: Fp 4:11 (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0843.def:
αὐτο-κατά-κριτος, -ον
(αὐτός, κατακρίνω),
self-condemned: Tt 3:11 (Eccl., Cremer, 377; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0844.def:
αὐτόματος -ον, and -η, -ον
(etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word), [in LXX, Lv 25:5, 11, 4Ki.19:29 (סָפִיחַ), Js 6:5, Jó 24:24, Wis.17:6 * ;]
__1. of persons, acting of one's own will.
__2. Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord: γῆ Mc 4:28 (MM, see word); πύλη, At 12:10.†
(AS)

G0846.def:
αὐτός, -ή, -ό,
determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399).
__1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii);
__(1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, Lc 5:37; αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, Jo 2:25; αὐ.ὑμεῖς, Jo 3:28; καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, Rm 15:14; αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, Jo 2:24; αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, Mc 2:25; ὑμεῖς αὐ., Mc 6:31; esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, Mt 3:4, Mc 6:17, Jo 16:27, 1Ts 3:11, al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, in that hour, Lc 10:21 (M, Pr., 91; MM, see word);
__(2) emphatic, he, she, it (M, Pr., 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), Mt 1:21, 12:50, Lc 6:35, al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), Mt 8:24, Mc 4:38, al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), Mt 14:2, Mc 14:15, 44, Lc 1:22, 2:28, al.
__2. In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), he, she, it, Mt 7:9, 10:12, 26:44, al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., Mt 9:18, Mc 13:1, al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), Mc 7:25, Ap 3:8, 7:2, al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, Mt 4:23, At 8:5, 2Co 2:13, al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, Rm 11:11, 1Ts 2:19, Tt 3:5, Hb 2:4.
__3. ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., the same: Hb 1:12, 13:8; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, Mt 5:46, 47, al.; φρονεῖν, Rm 12:16, 15:5, Fp 2:2, al.; τὰ αὐ., At 15:27, Rm 2:1, al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), At 14:1, Lc 6:23, al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., together (MM, see word), Mt 22:34, At 1:15, al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., 1Co 11:5, 12:11; with dative (cl.), 1Co 11:5; with a noun, λόγος, Mc 14:39; μέτρος, Fp 1:30; πνεῦμα, 1Co 12:4.
(AS)

G0847.def:
αὐτοῦ
adv., prop. neut. genitive of αὐτός, [in LXX for פֹּה, בָּזֶה ;]
there: Mt 26:36, Mc 6:33, WH, mg., Lc 9:27, At 15:34, WH, mg., R, mg., At 18:19 21:4 .†
(AS)

G0849.def:
αὐτό-χειρ, -ρος, ὁ, ἡ
(αὐτός, χείρ),
with one's own hand: At 27:19.†
(AS)

G0851.def:
ἀφ-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX (Cremer, 615 f.) for סוּר, עָבַר, H7311 כָּרַת, etc. (35 words in all) ;]
to take from, take away, take off: with accusative, τὸ ὠτίον, Mt 26:51, Mc 14:47 (ὠτάριον, WH), Lc 22:50 (οὖς); ὄνειδος, Lc 1:25; before ἀπό, Ap 22:19, Lc 16:3 (mid.); pass., C. genitive, Lc 10:42; ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, Hb 10:4, Rm 11:27 (mid.) (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0852.def:
ἀφανής, -ές
(φαίνω), [in LXX: Ne 4:8(2), Jó 24:20, Sir.20:30 41:14, 2Ma.3:34 * ;]
unseen, hidden: Hb 4:13.†
(AS)

G0853.def:
ἀφανίζω
(ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi., etc. ;]
__1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.).
__2. Later (MM, see word)
__(a) to destroy: Mt 6:19-20;
__(b) to disfigure: Mt 6:16. Pass., to vanish: Tg 4:14; to perish: At 13:41(LXX).†
(AS)

G0854.def:
ἀφανισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה ;]
vanishing: Hb 8:13.†
(AS)

G0855.def:
ἄφαντος, -ον
(φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word)
invisible, hidden: Lc 24:31.†
(AS)

G0856.def:
ἀφεδρών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(cf. ἄφεδρος, Lv 12:5) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word),
a privy, drain: Mt 15:17, Mc 7:19 (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).†
**ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὀχέω, to carry) [in Sm.: Jó 22:24, Sl 65:10 al. ;]
__1. a water-pipe, channel.
__2. the intestinal canal: Mc 7:19, WH, mg. (for ἀφεδρών).†
(AS)

G0857.def:
ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀφειδής, unsparing);
__1. extravagance.
__2. unsparing treatment, severity: Cl 2:23.†
(AS)

G0858.def:
ἀφελότης, -ητος, ἡ
= cl. ἀφέλεια (see MM, see word),
simplicity: At 2:46†
(AS)

G0859.def:
ἄφεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀφίημι), [in LXX for יוֹבֵל, דְּרוֹר, etc. (see Deiss., BS, 98 ff.; MM, see word) ;]
__1. dismissal, release: Lc 4:18.
__2. Metaphorical, of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, Mt 26:28, Mc 1:4, Lc 1:77 3:3 24:47, At 2:38 5:31 10:43 13:38 26:18, Cl 1:14; παραπτωμάτων, Ef 1:7; absol., Mc 3:29, Hb 9:22 10:18 (cf. DB, ii, 56; DCG, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).†
SYN.: πάρεσις, which see (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii) (AS)

G0860.def:
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;]
a joint (MM, see word): Ef 4:16, Cl 2:19 (Lft., in l).†
(AS)

G0861.def:
ἀφθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: Wis.2:23 6:19, 4Ma.9:22 4Mac 17:12 * ;]
incorruptibility, immortality: Rm 2:7, 1Co 15:42 15:50 15:53-54, 2Tm 1:10; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., Ef 6:24 (see AR, in l).†
ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ
(φθείρω), [in LXX: Ag 2:17 (שְׁדֵפָה)* ;]
uncorruptness: Tt 2:7 (Rec. ἀφθορία).†
(AS)

G0862.def:
ἄ-φθαρτος, -ον
(φθείρω), [in LXX: Wis.12:1 18:4 * ;]
imperishable, immortal;
__(a) of things: 1Co 9:25, 1Pe 1:4 1:23 3:4;
__(b) of persons: of men, 1Co 15:52; of God, Rm 1:23, 1Tm 1:17 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0863G.def:
ἀφ-ίημι,
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;]
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1Co 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Gn 35:18, Hdt., al.), Mt 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Mc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Mt 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Mt 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Mt 9:2, Rm 4:7" (LXX), 1Jo 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mc 2:5, Lc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Lc 5:23.
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Mt 4:11 5:24 15:14, Mc 1:20, 31 Jo 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Mc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hb 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Ap 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Mt 13:36 22:22, Mc 8:13, al.
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Mt 3:15; with accusative, Mt 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 5:40; with inf. pres., Mt 23:14, al.; aor., Mc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Mc 11:16, Jo 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Mt 7:4 27:49, Mc 15:36, Lc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).
(AS)

G0863H.def:
ἀφ-ίημι,
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;]
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1Co 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Gn 35:18, Hdt., al.), Mt 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Mc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Mt 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Mt 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Mt 9:2, Rm 4:7" (LXX), 1Jo 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mc 2:5, Lc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Lc 5:23.
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Mt 4:11 5:24 15:14, Mc 1:20, 31 Jo 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Mc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hb 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Ap 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Mt 13:36 22:22, Mc 8:13, al.
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Mt 3:15; with accusative, Mt 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 5:40; with inf. pres., Mt 23:14, al.; aor., Mc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Mc 11:16, Jo 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Mt 7:4 27:49, Mc 15:36, Lc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).
(AS)

G0863I.def:
ἀφ-ίημι,
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;]
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1Co 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Gn 35:18, Hdt., al.), Mt 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Mc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Mt 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Mt 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Mt 9:2, Rm 4:7" (LXX), 1Jo 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mc 2:5, Lc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Lc 5:23.
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Mt 4:11 5:24 15:14, Mc 1:20, 31 Jo 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Mc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hb 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Ap 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Mt 13:36 22:22, Mc 8:13, al.
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Mt 3:15; with accusative, Mt 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 5:40; with inf. pres., Mt 23:14, al.; aor., Mc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Mc 11:16, Jo 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Mt 7:4 27:49, Mc 15:36, Lc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).
(AS)

G0864.def:
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;]
perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), Rm 16:19.†
(AS)

G0865.def:
ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον
without love of good: 2Tm 3:3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0866.def:
ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον
without love of money, not avaricious; 1Tm 3:3, Hb 13:5. (For other instances, see MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0867.def:
ἄφ-ιξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: 3Ma.7:18 * ;]
in cl. usually, arrival; rarely, departure: At 20:29 (so in π., cf. MM, see word; M, Pv 26:1-28, n.).†
(AS)

G0868.def:
ἀφ-ίστημι
[in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;]
__1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, to move to revolt: At 5:37.
__2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: with genitive, Lc 2:37; before ἀπό, Lc 4:13 13:27, At 5:38 12:10 15:38 19:9 22:29, 2Co 12:8; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, 2Tm 2:19; ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), Hb 3:12 Mid. (exc. 1 aor., WH. is trans.), to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from: Lc 2:37; metaphorically, fall away, apostatize: absol., Lc 8:13; with genitive, 1Tm 4:1 (MM, see word; Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G0870.def:
ἀφόβως
adv. (φόβος), [in LXX: Pv 1:33 (פַּחַד), Wis.17:4 * ;]
without fear: Lc 1:74, Fp 1:14, 1Co 16:10, Ju 12.†
(AS)

G0871.def:
ἀφ-ομοιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Wis.13:14, Ep. Jer 1:5, 63, 71* ;]
to make like: pass., Hb 7:3.†
(AS)

G0872.def:
ἀφ-οράω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:10 (είς θεόν)* ;]
__(a) to look away from all else at, fix one's gaze upon: metaphorically (MM, see word), Hb 12:2;
__(b) simply, to see: ἀφίδω (see: ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phi., in l; MM, see word), Fp 2:23 (see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G0873.def:
ἀφ-ορίζω
[in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בָּדַל hi., סָגַר hi., נוּף hi., רוּם hi etc. ;]
__(a) to mark off by boundaries from, separate from: with accusative, At 19:9, Gl 2:12; id. before ἐκ (ἀπό), Mt 13:49 25:32 (MM, see word); of excom­munication, Lc 6:22. Pass., absol., 2Co 6:17;
__(b) to set apart, devote to a special purpose (before εἰς): with accusative, Gl 1:15. Mid., At 13:2, Rm 1:1 (DB, iii 588).†
(AS)

G0874.def:
ἀφ-ορμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Eze.5:7 (הָמוֹן), Pv 9:9, 3Ma.3:2 * ;]
prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaphorically, an occasion, incentive, opportunity (MM, see word): 2Co 11:12, Gl 5:13; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, Lc 11:24, WH, mg., Rm 7:8, 11; ἀφ. διδόναι, 2Co 5:12, 1Tm 5:14.*
(AS)

G0876.def: foam , of the sea, (Iliad by Homer): of an angry lion, foam, froth , (Iliad by Homer); ἀπ᾽ ἀνθρώπων ἀφρόν frothy blood , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

G0877.def:
ἀφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ἄφρων), [in LXX for אִוֶּלֶת, נְבָלָה, etc. ;]
foolishness: Mc 7:22, 2Co 11:1 11:17 11:21.†
(AS)

G0878.def:
ἄφρων, -ον genitive -ονος
(φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc. ;]
without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" (Hort; cf. MM, see word): Lc 11:40 12:20, Rm 2:20, 1Co 15:36, 2Co 11:16 12:6 12:11, 1Pe 2:15; opposite to φρόνιμος, 2Co 11:19; to συνιέντες, Ef 2:17.†
(AS)

G0879.def:
ἀφ-υπιόω, -ῶ
(ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: Gn 28:11 * ;]
__1. to awake from sleep (Anth.).
__2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), to fall asleep: Lc 8:23.†
(AS)

G0880.def:
ἀφωνος, -ον
(φωνή) [in LXX: Is 53:7 (עָלַם ni.), Wis.4:19, 2Ma.3:29 * ;]
dumb, speechless: At 8:32 (LXX); of idols (MM, see word), 1Co 12:2; of beasts, 2Pe 2:19; τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, unintelligible: 1Co 14:10.†
(AS)

G0882.def:
Ἀχαία (T, Ἀχαΐα), -ας, ἡ (Bl., § 46, 11)
Achaia, the Roman province: At 18:12, 27 19:21 Rm 15:26, 1Co 16:15, 2Co 1:1 9:2 11:10, 1Ts 1:7-8.†
(AS)

G0884.def:
ἀχάριστος, -ον
(χαρίζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.16:29, Sir.29:17, 25, 4Ma.9:10 * ;]
__(a) ungracious, unpleasing;
__(b) ungrateful, thankless: Lc 6:35, 2Tm 3:2.†
(AS)

G0886.def:
ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος, -ον
(χειροποίητος)
not made by hands: Mc 14:58, 2Co 5:1; metaphorically, περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual ), Cl 2:11 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0887.def:
ἀχλύς, -ύος, ἡ
[in Aq.: Eze.12:7; Sm.: Jó 3:5 * ;]
a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: At 13:11 (see Tr., Syn., § with).†
(AS)

G0888.def:
ἀ-χρεῖος, -ον
(χρεῖος, useful), [in LXX: 2Rs 6:22 (שָׁפָל), Ep. Jr 17:1-27 * ;]
useless, unprofitable: Mt 25:30, Lc 17:10 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0889.def:
ἀχρεόω (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ
(ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος) [in LXX (-ειόω) for אָלַח ni., etc. ;]
to make useless, unprofitable: pass., Rm 3:12 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0890.def:
ά-χρηατος, -ον
[in LXX: Os 8:8 (חֵפֶץ אַיִן), Wis.2:11, Sir.16:1, al. ;]
useless; unserviceable: opposite to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G0891.def:
ἄχρι
(and Epic ἄχρις, bef. vowel (see MM, see word), Rm 11:25 T, Gl 3:19 T, WH, mg., Hb 3:13);
__1. adv., utterly (Hom.).
__2. Prep. with genitive, until, unto, as far as;
__(a) of time At 3:21 22:22, Rm 1:13 5:13, 1Co 4:11, 2Co 3:14, Gl 4:2, Fp 1:6; ἄ. καιροῦ, Lc 4:13, At 13:11; ἄ. ἧς ἡμέρας, Mt 24:38, Lc 1:20 17:27, At 1:2 (τῆς ἡ. ἧς), At 1:22; ἄ. ταύτης τ. ἡμέρας (τ. ἡ. ταύτης), At 2:29 23:1 26:22; ἄ. ἡμερων πέντε, At 20:6; ἄ. αὐγῆς, At 20:11; ἄ. τοῦ νῦν, Rm 8:22, Fp 1:5; ἄ. τέλους, Hb 6:11, Ap 2:26;
__(b) of space: At 11:5 13:6 20:4 (R, txt., WH, mg.) At 28:15, 2Co 10:13-14, Hb 4:12, Ap 14:20 18:5;
__(with) of measure or degree: ἄ. θανάτου, At 22:4, Ap 2:10 12:11.
__3. As conj., until;
__(a) ἄχρι alone: with subj. aor., Gl 3:19 (ἄ. οὗ T, WH, mg.); id. without ἄν (Bl., § 65, 10), Ap 7:3 15:8 20:3, 5; with indic. fut., Ap 17:17;
__(b) ἄ. οὗ (i.e. ἄ.. τούτου ᾧ): with indic. aor., At 7:18; impf., At 27:33; with subj. aor. (Bl., ut supr.), Lc 21:24, Rm 11:25, 1Co 11:26 15:25, Gl 3:19, T, WH, mg.; id. with ἄν, Ap 2:25; with indic. pres., while, Hb 3:13 (cf. μέχρι).†
(AS)

G0892.def:
ἄχυρον, -ον, τό
[in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן ;]
chaff: Mt 3:12, Lc 3:17.†
(AS)

G0893.def:
ἀ-ψευδής, -ές
(ψεῦδος), [in LXX: Wis.7:17 * ;]
free from false-hood, truthful: Tt 1:2.†
(AS)

G0894.def:
ἄψινθος, -ου, ἡ
(also ἀψίνθιον, τό; ἀψινθία, ἡ),
wormwood: as a proper name, Ap 8:11.†
(AS)

G0896.def:
Βάαλ (Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord),
Baal: Rm 11:4 (LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (בֹּשֶׁת for בַּעַל), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ (cf. 3Ki.18:19), and to account for the frequently use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however, is not general, and in the passage cited in Ro (3Ki.19:18), LXX reads τῷ Β. †
(AS)

G0897.def:
Βαβυλών, -ῶνος, ἡ (בָּבֶל, Heb. form of Assyr. Bab-ili, Gate of God),
Babylon: Mt 1:11, 12 17, At 7:43" (LXX) ; symbolically, of Rome: Ap 14:8 16:19 17:5 18:2, 10, 21, and prob. also 1Pe 5:13.†
(AS)

G0898.def:
βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ, Ion. form of βασμός
(βαίνω, to step), [in LXX 1Rs 5:5 (מִפְתָּן), 4Ki.20:9, 10 11 (מַעֲלָה), Sir.6:36 * ;]
a step (4Ki, l.with, of degrees of a dial); metaphorically, a degree, standing: 1Tm 3:13.†
(AS)

G0899.def:
βάθος, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX for מְצוּלָה ,תַּחְתִּי, etc. ;]
depth: Mt 13:5, Mc 4:5, Rm 8:39, Ef 3:18; τὸ β., the deep sea: Lc 5:4; metaphorically, β. πλούτου . . . Θεοῦ, Rm 11:33; τὰ β. τ. Θεοῦ (the Divine counsels), 1Co 2:10; ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία, deep poverty, 2Co 8:2.†
(AS)
